cases.label: calliope-long-q3-off-a
command: On Tuesday evening, the hill observatory opened its workshop for a small repair class. Volunteers carried brass instruments from storage to the benches, where soft lamps lit every label. A meteorologist checked the barometers, while two apprentices cleaned salt from a weather vane brought in from the coast. Near the stairwell, an archivist unfolded star charts and copied each date into a new ledger. The caretaker measured a cracked window, replaced three screws, and marked the frame for tomorrow's carpenter. At the break, visitors traded stories about winter skies, ferry rides, and the first time they saw Saturn. Before the lesson ended, Inez arranged a shelf for spare lenses and wrote a clear note beside the emergency radio. The group agreed to meet again after sunrise, test every instrument, and return the repaired charts to the archive cabinet. Their careful work left the old observatory ready for another season of patient observations.
Speak clearly and naturally in English.

(root/(label+'.json')).write_text(json.dumps(record,indent=2)+'\n')
print(json.dumps(record),flush=True)
if p.returncode or len(rows)!=int(repeat) or hashes.returncode:sys.exit(1)
